SINAL Pui, PODLI

17-13-0303-C(1) Type 1 Narrative & Plans ~ 3448-62 W. Lawrence / 4807-11 N. St, Louis

Proposed Zoning: —_B1-3 Neighborhood Shopping District
Lot Area: 14,550.4 sq. ft. (116.41 ft. x 125 ft.)

Proposed Land Use: The subject property is improved with a three-story residential building
containing nine (9) dwelling units (fronting on N. St. Louis), and a two-
story building containing retail space at grade and vacant retail/office space
above (fronting on W. Lawrence Ave.). The two (2) existing buildings will
remain. The Applicant is proposing to establish eight (8) new residential
units on the second floor of the portion of the building that fronts on W.
Lawrence Ave. The existing 33 ft.-2 in. height dimension of the buildings
will remain. The footprint and floor area totals of the existing buildings will
also remain. The subject property is a Transit Served Location and will not
be supported by any off-street parking spaces. Pursuant to Sec, 17-13-0303-
D, the Applicant is seeking to reduce the number of off-street parking spaces
for a Transit Served Location from eight (8) to zero and waive the required
onsite loading berth. ;

(A) _ The Project’s Floor Area Ratio: 25,578 square feet (1.76 FAR)

(B) _ The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.): 855.91 square feet per D.U.
(9 existing residential units
plus 8 proposed residential
units for a total of 17
residential units.)

(C) The amount of off-street parking: 0 parking spaces

*Sec. 17-13-0303-D optional Administrative Adjustment and Variation; The
subject property is a designated Transit Served Location. Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-
1003-EE, the Applicant is seeking to reduce the number of off-street parking spaces
for the proposed seventeen (17) residential unit total from eight (8) parking spaces
to zero parking spaces. Please note nine (9) of the seventeen (17) residential units
exist today and are not supported by off-street parking spaces. The eight (8)
required off-street parking spaces relate to the eight (8) proposed residential units
in the portion of the building fronting on W. Lawrence Ave.

(D) Setbacks:

a. Front Setback: Zero
b. Side Setbacks: Zero
c *Rear Setback: N/A - Exempt

* The rear setback calculation was based on the Applicant opting to treat W.
Lawrence Ave. as the front of the subject property because it is a corner lot.


(E) Building Height: 33 feet 2 inches (existing to remain)

Sec. 17-3-0308 Criteria for Transit-Served Locations — Supplemental Narrative Zoning Analysis

1. The project complies with the applicable standards of Sec. 17-10-0102-B because the
subject property is located immediately adjacent to the Lawrence Ave. CTA Bus Line and
within approximately 600 linear feet of the Kimball CTA Train Station. While the resulting
mixed-use building will not be supported by any off-street vehicle parking spaces, it will
be supported by thirteen (13) bicycle parking spaces. Pursuant to Section 17-13-1003-EE,
the Applicant is seeking to permit a reduction in the required off-street vehicle parking
spaces.

2. The mixed-use building will comply with Sec. 17-3-0504 because its front setback along
W. Lawrence Ave. Parkway will remain at the front property line, the building entrance
width will not exceed 12 ft., the building entrance depth will not exceed the entrance width,
and the building entrance is not more than two-stories in height. The existing first floor
conditions on both sides of the building will remain without change.

3. The Transit Friendly Development Guide defines ‘transit friendly development’ as
development which is oriented towards and integrated with adjacent transit. The resulting
mixed-use building incorporates accessibility and connectivity to the Lawence Ave. CTA
Bus Line, which is immediately adjacent to the subject property’s south property line. The
subject property is also located within approximately 600 linear feet of the Kimball CTA
Train Station. The proposed building will offer thirteen (13) bicycle parking spaces and
onsite storage area. The Applicant believes the project will help improve the pedestrian
experience along W. Lawrence Ave. for residents and other commuters traveling in the
subject area, and at the same time, allow for the activation of vacant retail/office space
located on the second floor of the building fronting on W. Lawrence Ave.

4. The resulting mixed-use building will contain seventeen (17) dwelling units. Due to the
configuration of the buildings on the subject lot, no off-street parking can be provided. The
Applicant is seeking administrative approval to permit the parking reduction consistent
with the eTOD Ordinance.

5. The Applicant believes the resulting mixed-use building will retain a retail presence along
W. Lawerence Ave. (a designated Pedestrian Street) and provide appropriate density in the
Albany Park neighborhood. Based on the subject property’s proximity to a designated bus
route (Lawrence Ave. CTA Bus Line) and train station (CTA Kimball Train Station), the
Applicant believes the project complies with the Travel Demand Study and Management
Plan rules promulgated by the Department of Transportation by serving an area in need.
